subsidized employment programmes and direct employment programmes have large positive effects on the probability of exit to regular employment, that the effects are also positive for other types of programmes, and that the effects are largest when the programme begins after six months of social assistance.

active labour-market programmes for immigrants in Denmark receiving social assistance have positive effects on the exit rate from social assistance to regular employment, and that these effects are largest for the subsidised employment programmes, but are also significant and positive for direct employment programmes, training programmes, and other programmes.
